KyoubeAI moves to Paperclip core 2026.1023.0, and a Claude subscription now connects from the browser.

## What's in 1.15.0

**Claude signs in from the browser.** In **Connections**, or on an agent's **Runtime** tab, add a Claude subscription, open the sign-in link it shows, sign in, and paste the code Claude gives you back into the browser. The Terminal step and `kyoube connect claude` are gone. The core's own sign-in could not read what the Claude Code in the image prints: it waited on "Preparing browser sign-in…" for good, and past that it lost the token after you pasted the code. KyoubeAI fixes both with upstream's own changes until they ship (upstream issue #17868). Once connected, choose the subscription on each Claude Code agent's **Runtime** tab; an agent without one fails every run with "Not logged in".

**Private tasks and projects, from the core.** A task can be marked private when it is created, and a project can have its own member list. KyoubeAI's need-to-know visibility still applies on top. Kyoube's own plugins are not members of a private task, so an app's confirm-first actions, notify's notices, the Files link and an app's task tracking do not work on one ([docs/groups.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/groups.md#private-tasks-and-projects)).

**Model gateways, from the core.** **Connectors** gains OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, Google Gemini and your own Responses, Messages and Chat Completions endpoints, and an agent's **Runtime** tab picks one as its connection.

**Operators can change the company.** The core's Operator role grows from one grant to fourteen, including creating and configuring agents, connections and invitations. KyoubeAI follows the core; make anyone who should not configure agents a viewer ([docs/groups.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/groups.md#operators)).

**A new agent starts once its harness works.** A newly hired agent stays paused until its harness answers a test call to its model, and the core tries again every minute. Studio shows "Checking its AI connection" or "Waiting for its AI connection" meanwhile and links to the agent's **Runtime** tab. Claude Code agents now run on the core's bundled ACP engine; set `engine` to `cli` to keep the old behaviour for one.

**Fixes.** The Active, Paused and Error tabs of the agent list open the list again instead of a "does not exist" profile, and the org icon next to **Team** opens the org chart. A harness CLI that exits before reading its prompt no longer takes the whole server down.

## Update

From 1.14, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.14.1 from that backup. The core runs 28 database migrations on the first start, and two of them take longer on an instance with a long run history. Kyoube Studio moves to 0.6.2. Afterwards, connect your Claude subscription once in **Connections** and point each Claude Code agent at it on its **Runtime** tab. Read [Moving to 1.15](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/upgrading.md#moving-to-115) before you update.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
